tasks.title: Create local dev and test databases
tasks.description: A disposable local test database and a dev database exist, so the backend suite and API can run on this Windows PC.
tasks.details:
HUMAN, in Git Bash on the home PC (PostgreSQL 17 is installed and running on :5432). Run, entering the postgres superuser password when asked:
  "/c/Program Files/PostgreSQL/17/bin/psql" -U postgres -h 127.0.0.1 -c "CREATE ROLE azbuka_test LOGIN PASSWORD 'azbuka_test' CREATEDB" -c "CREATE DATABASE azbuka_test OWNER azbuka_test" -c "CREATE DATABASE azbuka_dev OWNER azbuka_test"
Then: setx AZBUKA_TEST_DB "postgresql://azbuka_test:azbuka_test@127.0.0.1:5432/azbuka_test" and open a new terminal. This role and password are local-only throwaway values (never used on the server). Reply 'done' when finished.
tasks.testStrategy: PGPASSWORD=azbuka_test "/c/Program Files/PostgreSQL/17/bin/psql" -h 127.0.0.1 -U azbuka_test -d azbuka_test -tAc 'select 1' prints 1, and the same for -d azbuka_dev.

tasks.title: Install dev dependencies and get every test suite green on Windows
tasks.description: One command runs the jsdom suite, build-in-sync check, course validator and backend pytest suite on this PC, all passing.
tasks.details: Create backend/venv (python -m venv backend/venv; backend/venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements-dev.txt) and run `cd tests && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund`. Run the AGENTS.md test command with AZBUKA_TEST_DB (default to postgresql://azbuka_test:azbuka_test@127.0.0.1:5432/azbuka_test if unset). Fix only Windows-specific failures (paths, CRLF, encoding: open files with encoding='utf-8'). Make scripts/test_backend.sh also work in Git Bash: if TEST_DATABASE_URL is unset and AZBUKA_TEST_DB is set, use it; pick backend/venv/Scripts/python.exe or backend/venv/bin/python, falling back to python3/python. Keep it POSIX sh. Log the pass counts (expected: 12 app tests, 26 backend tests).
tasks.testStrategy: The AGENTS.md test command exits 0; `sh scripts/test_backend.sh -q` exits 0 in Git Bash with AZBUKA_TEST_DB set.

tasks.title: Remove one-off patch scripts and archive stale agent prompts
tasks.description: The repo holds only live sources and docs; already-applied patch scripts and old prompt files no longer confuse builders.
tasks.details: git rm scripts/patch_m7.py scripts/patch_m7_fix.py scripts/patch_m7_polish.py scripts/patch_m8.py scripts/patch_m8_docs.py (their changes are already in build_standalone.py; git history keeps them). git mv CLAUDE_INSPECT_FINISH_AND_MERGE_PROMPT.md CLAUDE_MAIN_BRANCH_REPAIR_PROMPT.md CLAUDE_VPS_BACKEND_IMPLEMENTATION_BRIEF.md into docs/archive/. grep for references to the moved/removed names and fix links. Update the README 'Repository structure' block to list .taskmaster/, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, backend/, db/, docs/, tests/. Don't touch other docs.
tasks.testStrategy: python tests/check_build_in_sync.py passes; `git grep -n -e patch_m7 -e patch_m8 -e CLAUDE_MAIN_BRANCH_REPAIR -- ':!docs/archive'` prints nothing.

tasks.title: Run the API locally as a dev server
tasks.description: `python .claude/scripts/devserver.py start api` runs the FastAPI app against azbuka_dev so client sync can be built and tested locally.
tasks.details: Add an `api` entry to .claude/dev-servers.json (cwd backend; health http://127.0.0.1:8090/health). The API needs env vars: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://azbuka_test:azbuka_test@127.0.0.1:5432/azbuka_dev, APP_ORIGINS=http://127.0.0.1:4173,http://localhost:4173, TOKEN_PEPPER=<any 32+ chars, local only>. Read .claude/scripts/devserver.py to see how cmd runs (shell or not) and set them inline in cmd/cmd_windows, or add a tiny gitignored backend/.env.dev loader only if inline env is impossible. Apply migrations to azbuka_dev first: PGHOST=127.0.0.1 PGUSER=azbuka_test PGPASSWORD=azbuka_test PGDATABASE=azbuka_dev MIGRATIONS_DIR=db sh db/apply_migrations.sh (needs psql on PATH: /c/Program Files/PostgreSQL/17/bin). Document both steps in backend/README.md under 'Local dev'.
tasks.testStrategy: python .claude/scripts/devserver.py start api && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8090/health returns ok JSON; psql on azbuka_dev: select count(*) from course_units = 16; then devserver.py stop api.

tasks.title: Device ID and durable local event queue
tasks.description: Every learner action becomes an append-only event with a UUID in a durable local queue, saved before any network call; the app is unchanged offline and signed out.
tasks.details: In scripts/build_standalone.py (never standalone.html): add state.sync = {deviceId, queue:[], cursor:null, lastSyncAt:null, account:null}, created once in normalizeState (old saved state must load). Emit events for review rated, checkpoint answered, unit completed and xp-awarded (with the existing stable per-item, per-day reward key). Match the event shapes and id charset (letters, digits, ._:@-) accepted by POST /v1/sync/events in backend/app/main.py and backend/README.md. Use crypto.randomUUID with a fallback. Cap the queue (e.g. 5000) without dropping unsynced events silently: show a warning. Rebuild standalone.html and bump CACHE in service-worker.js. Add jsdom tests in tests/app.test.js.
tasks.testStrategy: (cd tests && npm test --silent) && python tests/check_build_in_sync.py; new tests prove: deviceId stable across reloads, rating a card appends one event with a valid id, old saved state without `sync` loads.

tasks.title: Upload the event queue to the API
tasks.description: While signed in and online, queued events upload in batches with capped backoff; accepted and duplicate events are marked synced, rejected ones kept with a plain error.
tasks.details: In build_standalone.py: API base = same-origin '/api' when served over https, else a value from localStorage 'azbuka-api-base' (default http://127.0.0.1:8090) so local dev works. Batch up to MAX_SYNC_EVENTS (250), reuse the same event ids on retry, backoff 2s doubling to 5 min, trigger on login, on 'online', after each new event (debounced) and on a timer. Bearer token from login stored in state.sync.account. 401 → signed-out state, keep the queue. Never block the UI. Add jsdom tests with a stubbed fetch (accepted, duplicate, rejected, network error, 401).
tasks.testStrategy: (cd tests && npm test --silent) && python tests/check_build_in_sync.py; stubbed-fetch tests cover all five responses; with the api dev server running, a scripted register+upload via the built app logic shows events in azbuka_dev (select count(*) from sync_events or the table backend uses).

tasks.title: Account screen: register, login, logout, sync status
tasks.description: A learner can create an account, sign in and out, and see local-only / syncing / synced / queued / error status, last sync time, pending count and a Sync Now button.
tasks.details: New screen or panel in build_standalone.py, reachable from the existing navigation, in the existing neo-brutalist style. Uses /v1/auth/register, /v1/auth/login, /v1/auth/logout, /v1/me. Keep the existing export/import/reset controls on it. Plain error messages (wrong password, rate limited, offline). Password field type=password, autocomplete attributes set, font-size >= 16px. Follow the mobile-ui-check skill.
tasks.testStrategy: (cd tests && npm test --silent) && python tests/check_build_in_sync.py; jsdom tests with stubbed fetch: register → signed-in view with email; logout → local-only; pending count equals queue length. MANUAL CHECK: mobile-ui-check checklist at 390x844.

tasks.title: Restore and merge progress after login
tasks.description: After login the app pulls the account's progress and merges it with local progress without ever losing offline work; a second browser restores the same progress.
tasks.details: Split into subtasks. Server side already exists: GET /v1/sync/bootstrap and GET /v1/sync/changes?cursor= (see backend/README.md, including the overlapping-sync cursor limitation).
tasks.testStrategy: See subtasks.

subtasks.title: Pure merge function with tests
subtasks.description: A merge(local, remote) function combines two progress states with no loss: max of counters per item, union of completed units and badges, latest review date wins, XP display from server totals.
subtasks.details: In build_standalone.py as a pure function (no DOM, no fetch) so jsdom tests can call it. Define exactly how each field in state merges and write it in a comment above the function.
subtasks.testStrategy: (cd tests && npm test --silent) && python tests/check_build_in_sync.py; tests: empty remote never wipes local; remote-only items appear; conflicting item keeps the later review; merge(a,b) then merge with b again is unchanged (idempotent).

subtasks.title: First-login merge step and bootstrap call
subtasks.description: On first login on a browser with local progress, the learner is asked to merge this browser's progress into the account; nothing is replaced by an empty account.
subtasks.details: After login: call /v1/sync/bootstrap, then changes with the saved cursor, apply merge(), save locally, then upload any local events not yet on the server. If local has progress and the account is new/empty, show a clear one-tap 'Merge this browser's progress into my account' prompt (default: merge).
subtasks.testStrategy: (cd tests && npm test --silent) && python tests/check_build_in_sync.py; jsdom test with stubbed fetch: local progress + empty account → after confirm, local progress unchanged and events queued for upload.

subtasks.title: Periodic re-bootstrap and cursor handling
subtasks.description: The app re-runs bootstrap after login and periodically so a missed event from overlapping syncs still arrives.
subtasks.details: Save the changes cursor in state.sync.cursor; poll changes on the sync timer; full bootstrap+merge every ~30 min while open and on visibilitychange to visible.
subtasks.testStrategy: (cd tests && npm test --silent) && python tests/check_build_in_sync.py; jsdom test with fake timers: bootstrap called again after the interval; cursor persisted across reload.

tasks.title: Client sync end-to-end check against the local API
tasks.description: A script proves the PRD sync criteria locally: offline progress survives refresh, the queue drains with no duplicates when the API returns, and a second browser profile restores the same progress.
tasks.details: Add tests/sync_e2e.test.js (jsdom, real fetch to http://127.0.0.1:8090) runnable as `node tests/sync_e2e.test.js`; skip with a clear message if the API isn't up. Steps: API down → complete actions → reload → progress there; API up → queue drains; send same batch twice → XP and attempts unchanged; fresh 'profile' (new localStorage) logs in → same progress. Add it to tests/package.json as `test:e2e`. Update docs/MASTER_PLAN.md Phase 2 checkboxes.
tasks.testStrategy: python .claude/scripts/devserver.py start api && (cd tests && npm run test:e2e --silent) exits 0. MANUAL CHECK: two real browser profiles on the PC show the same progress after login.

tasks.title: Verify the VPS kit works from this PC
tasks.description: `ssh vps` answers, so deploy tasks can run unattended.
tasks.details: Run `ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 vps version` and `ssh vps help`; record the version and the subcommand list (especially any backup/offsite/download command) in the task log. If it fails with Permission denied or unknown host, stop: HUMAN NEEDED, set up the kit per master-harness library/vps-kit/README.md.
tasks.testStrategy: ssh -o BatchMode=yes vps version exits 0.

tasks.title: Make the API and migrations read the VPS kit's environment
tasks.description: The same code runs locally and on the kit: config from the kit's .env (DATABASE_URL, ALLOWED_ORIGINS, SECRET_KEY, PORT) with the existing names still working.
tasks.details: backend/app/main.py: APP_ORIGINS falls back to ALLOWED_ORIGINS; TOKEN_PEPPER falls back to SECRET_KEY (kit-managed random value); still refuse to start if neither is set. Honour the /api/ prefix being stripped by the proxy (no root_path change needed unless docs links break; check). db/apply_migrations.sh: if DATABASE_URL is set, pass it to every psql call (psql "$DATABASE_URL"), else keep PG* vars; MIGRATIONS_DIR still overrides the dir. Keep POSIX sh. Update .env.example comments and backend/README.md. Docker Compose must keep working unchanged.
tasks.testStrategy: Backend test command passes; new pytest checks the fallbacks (env ALLOWED_ORIGINS only → CORS allows it; SECRET_KEY only → starts). `DATABASE_URL=postgresql://azbuka_test:azbuka_test@127.0.0.1:5432/azbuka_dev MIGRATIONS_DIR=db sh db/apply_migrations.sh` run twice prints only skip/repeat the second time.

tasks.title: Add deploy/vps.json and a static build output
tasks.description: The kit can build and serve the static app and the API on one HTTPS origin, with the API under /api/.
tasks.details: scripts/build_standalone.py (or a small scripts/build_dist.py) also writes dist/ with index.html (= standalone.html), standalone.html, manifest.json, service-worker.js and nothing else (never serve the repo root: it holds backend code and docs). dist/ stays gitignored. deploy/vps.json per the vps skill: web {dir: '.', build: 'python3 scripts/build_dist.py' (or equivalent), out: 'dist'}; api {dir: 'backend', runtime: 'python', start: 'venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port $PORT --proxy-headers', migrate: 'MIGRATIONS_DIR=.. sh ../db/apply_migrations.sh' (adjust to how the kit runs it; one line), health: '/health', path: '/api/'}. Check the service worker scope and CACHE list still work when served as index.html at /. The app's API base on https is '/api' (task 6).
tasks.testStrategy: Run the build command locally: dist/ contains exactly the 4 files; python -c json.load on deploy/vps.json; with `python -m http.server -d dist 4174` curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:4174/ returns the app.

tasks.title: Security review before first deploy
tasks.description: Run the security-review skill over secrets, auth, input, web and dependencies and file every finding as a fix task.
tasks.details: Follow .claude/skills/security-review/SKILL.md (one reviewer dispatch per area; skip the Server area, the kit manages it). Fix high/critical findings in this phase as new tasks before task 14; medium/low go to later phases.
tasks.testStrategy: Every finding is a task (tasks.py status lists them); no open high/critical finding before task 14 runs.

tasks.title: Create the azbuka app on the VPS and deploy
tasks.description: The app and API are live on the VPS at azbuka.andel-vps.space via `git push vps main`.
tasks.details: Follow the vps skill: `ssh vps create azbuka --domain azbuka.andel-vps.space --db`, `git remote add vps vps:/srv/git/azbuka.git`, ensure git status is clean and tests pass, `git push vps main`. Read the output (OK ... is live or FAILED: <step>); on failure `ssh vps logs azbuka --deploy -n 80`, fix, commit, push again; never push the same failing commit twice. Check `ssh vps env-keys azbuka` shows the keys the API needs. Do not touch other apps.
tasks.testStrategy: git push vps main ends with OK ... is live; ssh vps status azbuka shows running.

tasks.title: TLS and production smoke test
tasks.description: The public site and /api/health answer over HTTPS, plain HTTP redirects, CORS allows only the app origin and PostgreSQL is not reachable from outside.
tasks.details: `ssh vps tls azbuka` if HTTPS is missing. Then curl checks: https://azbuka.andel-vps.space/ 200; https://azbuka.andel-vps.space/api/health 200; http:// → 301/308 to https; preflight with Origin: https://evil.example gets no Access-Control-Allow-Origin; `nc -z -w5 2.25.108.3 5432` (or python socket) fails. Put these in scripts/smoke_prod.sh for reuse.
tasks.testStrategy: sh scripts/smoke_prod.sh exits 0. MANUAL CHECK: open the site on a phone, the mic prompt appears on a voice exercise.

tasks.title: Choose off-server backup storage
tasks.description: The owner picks where the encrypted nightly database dump goes off the VPS and creates its credentials.
tasks.details: HUMAN. The kit already takes nightly dumps on the server (task 10 logged whether it has an offsite/download command). Pick one: (a) pull to the home PC on a schedule, (b) an S3-compatible bucket (Backblaze B2, etc.), (c) another machine. Create the credentials yourself; set them with `ssh vps env-set azbuka KEY=VALUE` or keep them on the home PC; never paste secrets into chat. Reply with the choice and the variable names.
tasks.testStrategy: The task log names the storage choice and where its credentials live (names only).

tasks.title: Ship an encrypted off-server copy of the nightly dump
tasks.description: Each night's database dump ends up encrypted outside the VPS with 14-30 days of retention.
tasks.details: Implement the owner's choice from task 16 with the kit's commands (`ssh vps backup azbuka`, any download/offsite subcommand). If the kit can't do it without admin rights, write the exact admin command or home-PC scheduled script (Windows Task Scheduler + Git Bash) and make it a human step. Encrypt with age or gpg; keys never in Git.
tasks.testStrategy: After one run, the off-server location lists a dump from today; decrypting it with the owner's key yields a valid pg_dump file (pg_restore --list succeeds).

tasks.title: Write the operations runbook
tasks.description: docs/OPERATIONS.md holds exact commands for deploy, rollback, logs, backups, restore, secret rotation and schema migrations on the kit.
tasks.details: Short and command-first. Restore and app deletion are admin-only: give the exact `sudo vps-agent restore ...` form from the vps skill/`ssh vps help`. Migrations: add a numbered file to db/migrations/, push; the kit runs the migrate step. Link it from README.md and docs/MASTER_PLAN.md.
tasks.testStrategy: File exists, every command in it appears in `ssh vps help` output or the repo; markdown links resolve.

tasks.title: Test a restore into a scratch database
tasks.description: The owner restores last night's backup into a scratch database and the row counts match production.
tasks.details: HUMAN, following docs/OPERATIONS.md: run the admin restore into a scratch db (never the live one), then compare counts for users, sync events, xp_ledger and course_units against production. Paste the two count lists (no data) into the task log.
tasks.testStrategy: Counts match table by table; the log holds both lists.

tasks.title: Automated production acceptance script
tasks.description: One script proves the PRD's server criteria on the live app: auth, idempotency, isolation, CORS, HTTPS, closed 5432.
tasks.details: scripts/acceptance_prod.sh (or .py, stdlib only) against https://azbuka.andel-vps.space/api: register two throwaway accounts (prefix accept-<timestamp>@example.invalid), login, /v1/me, logout → same token 401; send the same event twice → second is duplicate and progress summary unchanged; account B cannot read A's progress; bad token 401. Reuse scripts/smoke_prod.sh for HTTPS/CORS/5432. Mind the API rate limits (sleep between auth calls).
tasks.testStrategy: The script exits 0 against production and prints one PASS line per PRD criterion.

tasks.title: Regression check: course, build and old saved data
tasks.description: Units 1-16 render, every play button speaks its own card, and an old saved state from before sync still loads.
tasks.details: Extend tests/app.test.js: render each of the 16 units; for each play button assert speechSynthesis.speak gets that card's text; load a fixture of a pre-sync localStorage state (copy shape from git history before task 5) and assert progress is kept. Also run the validator and node --check on the extracted inline script.
tasks.testStrategy: The AGENTS.md test command exits 0 with the new tests.

tasks.title: Real-phone acceptance pass
tasks.description: The owner confirms on a real phone: lesson offline and signed out, refresh keeps progress, queue drains when back online, second device restores.
tasks.details: HUMAN, on the phone and a second device/browser at https://azbuka.andel-vps.space: 1) airplane mode, do a lesson, reload → progress kept; 2) back online, signed in → status shows synced, pending 0; 3) log in on the second device → same progress; 4) speak a phrase on a voice exercise → transcript appears. Report pass/fail per step.
tasks.testStrategy: All four steps reported pass in the task log.

tasks.title: Update the plan docs and the parity table
tasks.description: docs/MASTER_PLAN.md and the README reflect what is live, and each of the 15 original features has a status (built, planned in phase 5, deferred to v2, dropped).
tasks.details: Edit docs/MASTER_PLAN.md status table, definition of done and parity table to match tasks.json; deferred items match the PRD's Later list. No new scope.
tasks.testStrategy: git diff shows the doc updates; every parity row has one of the four statuses.

tasks.title: Word of the Day with a daily reminder popup
tasks.description: Each day the app shows one Word of the Day picked from due or weak items, with a dismissible popup on first open that day.
tasks.details: build_standalone.py only; no server. Pick deterministically per date from due/weak items (fallback: next new item). Popup once per local calendar day, stored in state; speak button on it. Record the view as an event if it affects progress.
tasks.testStrategy: (cd tests && npm test --silent) && python tests/check_build_in_sync.py; jsdom tests: same word all day, new word next day, popup shows once per day. MANUAL CHECK: mobile-ui-check.

tasks.title: Quiz: English to Russian multiple choice
tasks.description: Learners can take quizzes in the English → Russian direction with the same adaptive picker and XP rules.
tasks.details: Reuse the existing Russian → English quiz code path with a direction parameter; choices are Russian words with speak buttons. XP reward keys must stay unique per direction.
tasks.testStrategy: (cd tests && npm test --silent) && python tests/check_build_in_sync.py; jsdom tests: EN→RU question shows English prompt and Russian choices; answering right twice gives XP once per key.

tasks.title: Quiz: fill-in-the-blank and typed answer
tasks.description: Learners can fill a blank in a pattern sentence and type a Russian answer, with tolerant checking.
tasks.details: Typed answers: normalise case, trim, treat ё = е, ignore final punctuation; accept Latin transliteration only if a task log says so (default: Cyrillic only, show the on-screen hint). Blanks come from existing pattern sentences in a1-course.json. Input font-size >= 16px, lang=ru on inputs.
tasks.testStrategy: (cd tests && npm test --silent) && python tests/check_build_in_sync.py; jsdom tests for the normaliser (ё/е, case, punctuation) and one blank question end to end.

tasks.title: Word bank: search, tags and custom words
tasks.description: Learners can search all words, filter by tag (unit/topic), and add their own words that join review and sync.
tasks.details: Search over ru, transliteration and en. Tags from unit ids/topics. Custom words stored in state and emitted as events so they sync; they enter adaptive review like course items. Do not expand the built-in course (non-goal).
tasks.testStrategy: (cd tests && npm test --silent) && python tests/check_build_in_sync.py; jsdom tests: search finds by English and Cyrillic; custom word appears in review and in the event queue. MANUAL CHECK: mobile-ui-check.

tasks.title: Weekly leaderboard (opt-in, server-side XP)
tasks.description: Signed-in learners can opt in with a display name and see this week's top XP from the server's xp_ledger.
tasks.details: Split into subtasks. Server-side XP only; opted-out users never appear; display names are validated and length-limited.
tasks.testStrategy: See subtasks.

subtasks.title: Leaderboard migration and endpoint
subtasks.description: A migration adds the opt-in display name, and GET /v1/leaderboard/weekly returns the top 20 opted-in users by this week's xp_ledger total.
subtasks.details: db/migrations/003_leaderboard.sql (nullable display_name, leaderboard_opt_in boolean default false). PUT /v1/me/leaderboard to set both. Week = ISO week in UTC; document it. db-migration skill.

subtasks.title: Leaderboard opt-in setting and view
subtasks.description: The account screen has an opt-in toggle with display name, and a leaderboard view shows this week's top 20 with the learner's own rank.
subtasks.details: build_standalone.py; works only signed in and online, shows a friendly message otherwise. Never send local XP; display server numbers only.
subtasks.testStrategy: (cd tests && npm test --silent) && python tests/check_build_in_sync.py; jsdom tests with stubbed fetch: opt-in sends PUT; view renders 20 rows. MANUAL CHECK: mobile-ui-check.

tasks.title: Tutor personas

tasks.details: Two original Russian personas (equivalents of the original 'Tutor Magda' and 'Coach Piotr'; pick fitting Russian names and write the copy). Persona stored in state; phrasing used in feedback messages; preferred voice gender/name when the device has one, else fall back silently.
tasks.testStrategy: (cd tests && npm test --silent) && python tests/check_build_in_sync.py; jsdom test: switching persona changes a feedback string and persists across reload.

metadata.description: Azbuka master plan. Source of truth; TASKS.md is generated from this.
